sources.note: Alberta Innovates' own programme page for the Graduate Student Scholarships (awarding body site); shows Program Status: Active, Intake Status: Open, Due date: Continuous.

University of Calgary Faculty of Graduate Studies page for the Alberta Innovates Graduate Student Scholarships (delivering institution); gives award values, citizenship, research areas, and the ET development-vs-use eligibility rule.

UCalgary Graduate Award Competition (GAC) page, which administers the Alberta Innovates application at that institution; states the competition opens November 1, deadlines vary by program, and the Faculty of Graduate Studies February 1 deadline.

awarding_body.detail: The page is on albertainnovates.ca, the awarding agency's own site, and presents the Graduate Student Scholarships programme administered through the five participating Alberta post-secondary institutions, matching the record's awarding body and its 'delivered through participating Alberta post-secondary institutions' framing.
awarding_body.quote: The Graduate Student Scholarships program provides funding to enable full-time graduate students to research emerging technologies at participating post-secondary institutions.

deadline.detail: The programme page gives the due date as 'Continuous' with a Seasonal Intake and states the intake open date is specific to each individual university, exactly as the record states. Intake Status is Open as of today (12 October 2026), so a cycle is currently open. The UCalgary details quoted in the record (Graduate Award Competition opens November 1 of each year, deadlines vary by program, FGS February 1 reference deadline) were each confirmed verbatim on the UCalgary pages.
deadline.quote: Due date: Continuous ... This program is accepting applications on a seasonal basis. Intake Open Date is specific to each individual university; please contact your university of choice for deadline information.

eligibility.detail: Confirmed on the Alberta Innovates page: open to Canadian, permanent resident, and international graduate students conducting full-time research in information and communications technologies (ICT) and advanced materials and manufacturing technologies (AMM) at one of five named institutions. The record's further claims are confirmed on the UCalgary page: projects that merely use ET as a tool are not eligible (development, not use), and applicants must clearly articulate potential impacts for Alberta.
eligibility.quote: This scholarship program is open to Canadian, permanent resident, and international graduate students conducting full-time research in key emerging technology areas of information and communications technologies (ICT) and advanced materials and manufacturing technologies (AMM) at one of the following post-secondary institutions.

funding.detail: The award is a stipend-type scholarship of $12,000 to $31,000 per year for terms of one to four years — not fully funded and not tuition-only, matching the record's 'Stipend' classification. UCalgary specifies $26,000 for master's (up to two years) and $31,000 for doctoral (up to four years), plus optional AGES ($18,000) and Major Award ($12,000) top-ups.
funding.quote: The program offers funding ranging from $12,000 to $31,000 per year, and the terms vary from one to four years, depending on the recipient’s time in the program.

degree_levels.detail: Master's and PhD confirmed. The Alberta Innovates page addresses full-time graduate students; UCalgary specifies thesis-based master's and doctoral programs with level-specific values.

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: Due date: Continuous (Seasonal Intake). "This program is accepting applications on a seasonal basis. Intake Open Date is specific to each individual university; please contact your university of choice for deadline information." At the University of Calgary the application runs through the Graduate Award Competition, which "opens November 1 of each year"; "Deadlines vary by program (BISI, EDER, PSYC, ect)"; the Faculty of Graduate Studies reference deadline is February 1.
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Re-checked live 2026-10-12 against albertainnovates.ca (Program Status: Active; Intake Status: Open; Due date: Continuous; seasonal intake, per-university open dates) and the UCalgary Faculty of Graduate Studies pages. No single calendar deadline exists anywhere in the chain, so the record's deadline_precision 'varies' and its wording are correct as they stand. Funding $12,000-$31,000 per year, terms one to four years (UCalgary: $26,000 master's up to two years; $31,000 doctoral up to four years). The AI 2026-2027 Program Guidelines PDF linked from the programme page could not be text-extracted by the fetch tool (binary response), so eligibility wording was verified via the programme page and the UCalgary pages instead; a future re-check could read that PDF directly.
